content.content: deccy is one CLI, for humans and agents alike, that maintains a decision graph in any repo. It initialises a repository for the graph, creates decision nodes, performs operations on nodes (recording file edits into their owning nodes, removing nodes), and undoes/redoes operations. It never authors node content; content is written by humans and agents.
content.rationale: Graph bookkeeping is mechanical and repeatable, but node content must stay authored by its owners; one CLI keeps humans and agents working through the same guarded operations.
